stories.title: ALCS tied 2-2 — WS starts Friday, Cubs QO clock ticking
stories.angle: ALCS G4 result (Rays 7-3, tied 2-2); G5 today 4 PM CT. WS opens Oct 23 vs Brewers at Milwaukee. QO window opens 5 days after WS. Suzuki/Happ decisions imminent.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
The ALCS is tied 2-2. Game 5 is today at 4 PM CT.

Whoever wins faces the Brewers in a World Series starting Oct. 23 in Milwaukee.

The Cubs' QO window opens 5 days after the WS ends. Suzuki and Happ decisions coming fast.

stories.title: Seiya Suzuki — .270/.368/.473, 26 HR, 5.1 WAR walking out the door
stories.angle: Standalone Suzuki analysis (Oct 14 had dual Happ+Suzuki framing). He's 32 with Gold Glove finalist stats and $100M+ market value. Cubs "unlikely to compete in bidding war" per multiple reports. Blue Jays pursuing. Bold departure analysis.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Seiya Suzuki: .270/.368/.473, 26 HR, 5.1 WAR, Gold Glove finalist.

He's 32 and likely to see $100M+ on the open market. Multiple reports say the Cubs aren't expected to compete in that bidding war.

Letting that production walk is a choice. Own it.

stories.title: Cubs rotation crisis — Imanaga, Gausman, Horton, Boyd all uncertain
stories.angle: Oct 14 covered Sonny Gray specifically. Today = full-scale picture: 3-4 starters potentially gone, Horton out until mid-2027 (second TJ surgery April 2026). $100M+ budget. Biggest offseason challenge.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Imanaga: gone. Gausman: likely gone. Horton: out until mid-2027. Boyd: uncertain.

The Cubs could be replacing 3-4 starters this offseason.

They reportedly have $100M+ to spend. How this rotation gets rebuilt defines the 2027 season.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Four contract options shape the Cubs' free agent spending capacity
stories.angle: Boyd ($15M mutual), Holmes ($12M player), Rea ($7.5M club), Webb ($2.5M club) = $37M in decisions converging in same window as QO deadline. Framed as offseason architecture, NOT bare transactions.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Four contract option calls — Boyd, Holmes, Rea, Webb — will shape the Cubs' free agent budget before the market even opens.

Combined value: roughly $37 million.

That's not just roster decisions. That's offseason architecture.

stories.angle: Oct 14 = first dedicated Hartshorn feature. Today: Double-A debut (Sept 12), .317/.429/.556 at High-A, 100 RBIs (first Cubs teen in 2+ decades), MLB Pipeline No. 39. Different angle from Oct 14.

Josiah Hartshorn: .317/.429/.556 at High-A, 100 RBIs at 19 years old.

stories.title: NL Central final standings — Brewers 103-59, Cubs 89-73, Cardinals 77-85
stories.angle: Division hierarchy in stark terms. Brewers 103-59 in WS. Cubs 89-73 Wild Card exit (14 GB). Cardinals 77-85 watching from home. Bold take on where Cubs sit and the gap that needs closing.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
The NL Central in 2026:
— Brewers: 103-59, World Series
— Cubs: 89-73, Wild Card exit
— Cardinals: 77-85, watching at home

14 games behind. The Cardinals used to set this division's ceiling.

Now the Brewers do. And the Cubs are in between.
